payloadSchema.title: policy.snapshot@1
payloadSchema.description: An immutable capture of mutable configuration a run depended on: thresholds, checklists, rulesets, charts of accounts.

notes: Every run whose result depends on a threshold must declare the snapshot as an input with role 'policy'.

The mock-up needs at least three: inbox classify threshold 0.8, the reconciliation auto-threshold behind 'Score 91 % — knapp unter der Auto-Schwelle', and the tax checklist behind 'fehlend laut Checkliste'.
values is an open object at kernel level; each policyKey should be given a bounded schema in a later version rather than widening this one.
